rulesinformation.title: Fees and Expenses
rulesinformation.instruction: Verify that the clause defines the budget and requires XYZInc to pay invoices within the stated timeframe
rulesinformation.description: Specifies budget and invoice payment timing.

rulesinformation.title: Consulting Services
rulesinformation.instruction: Ensure the clause requires the Service Provider to issue a revised SOW within the specified timeframe when Company requests changes, and that both parties must sign it.
rulesinformation.description: Explains how changes to the scope must be handled.

rulesinformation.title: Term/Termination
rulesinformation.instruction: Ensure the clause requires the Service Provider to return any unused payments or advances after termination or expiration
rulesinformation.description: Requires return of unused funds upon termination.

rulesinformation.title: Non-Compete
rulesinformation.instruction: Ensure the clause requires continued confidentiality of XYZInc Proprietary Information after the non‑compete expires or becomes unenforceable.
rulesinformation.description: States that confidentiality obligations continue even after the non‑compete ends.

rulesinformation.title: Term/Termination - Fallback 1
rulesinformation.instruction: Ensure the clause establishes that the Service Provider is responsible for properly accounting for all funds provided by the Company and must remit any amounts not used for authorized purposes.
rulesinformation.description: Use this fallback when the clause does not mention “return” but imposes accountability for Company‑provided funds.

rulesinformation.title: Term/Termination - Fallback 2
rulesinformation.instruction: Verify that the clause requires the Service Provider to settle outstanding financial balances at termination, including returning any remaining funds, credits, or unspent amounts provided by the Company.
rulesinformation.description: Use this fallback when the clause does not explicitly state “return unused advances,” but still implies a financial reconciliation at termination.

textinformation.text: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement (“Agreement”) is dated as of April 9, 2026 (the “Effective Date”), by and between XYZInc Inc., (hereinafter “XYZInc”) having a mailing address of 2603 Camino Ramon, Suite 200, San Ramon, CA 94583, and Amtrino Technologies (hereinafter “Service Provider”), having an address, at 6088 Dublin Meadows St, Dublin, CA.
RECITALS

WHEREAS, XYZInc desires to retain Service Provider to perform consulting services and deliver certain deliverables as defined in one or more Statements of Work as provided herein (the “Consulting Services”); and
WHEREAS, in consideration of consulting fees to be paid to Service Provider by XYZInc, Service Provider will provide the specified consulting services to XYZInc.
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein, XYZInc and Service Provider (each a “Party” and together, the “Parties”) agree as follows:

Relationship with XYZInc.  Service Provider’s work hereunder is being carried out as an independent contractor and not as an employee or agent of XYZInc.  Notwithstanding the foregoing, Service Provider agrees to comply with all applicable laws, ordinances, codes and regulations of federal, state, and local governments, and all rules, policies and regulations established by XYZInc, including XYZInc’s Code of Conduct.  Service Provider will not participate in employee benefit plans or receive any other payments beyond those listed in each Statement of Work provided in Exhibit A “Statements of Work and Fees” or any other written agreement with XYZInc.  Payments hereunder shall be without deduction for taxes of any kind.  Any taxes payable as a result of Service Provider’s compensation hereunder shall be entirely Service Provider’s responsibility.
Non-Compete.

During the term of Service Provider’s consultancy and for one (1) year thereafter, Service Provider will not, without XYZInc’s prior written consent, directly or indirectly work on any high frequency spinal cord stimulation (SCS) (in the frequency range of 1,500-100,000 hertz) products, services, preclinical studies or clinical studies.

When the non-compete provision of Section 2.1 expires or is otherwise unenforceable, Service Provider acknowledges the continued duty to maintain in confidence any and all XYZInc Proprietary Information.
Consulting Services.

Each project for which XYZInc desires to engage Service Provider shall be set forth in detail in a separate writing (each a “Statement of Work”) to be duly signed by authorized representatives of the Parties.  Each Statement of Work will address the following, as applicable: scope of the Consulting Services, proposed approach, deliverables, pricing, key assumptions, staffing, responsibilities of both parties, estimated project schedule, professional arrangements, and such other matters as to which the parties may agree (collectively, the “Deliverables”).  Each Statement of Work must be accompanied by a Purchase Order sent by XYZInc to Service Provider and incorporated herein by reference as a sequentially numbered Exhibit (i.e., Exhibit A-1, A-2, etc.).

In the event that XYZInc requests any change to the scope of the Consulting Services, the Service Provider may, at its discretion, determine whether a revised Statement of Work is necessary. Any such revision, if prepared, does not need to be completed within a specific timeframe, nor is it required to reflect all requested changes or associated costs. Furthermore, the revised Statement of Work does not require signatures from both Parties and may be implemented without formal execution or attachment as an Exhibit.
In the event of a conflict between the terms of this Agreement and those of a Statement of Work, the terms of this Agreement shall prevail.
Term/Termination.

This Agreement commences as of the Effective Date.  Unless earlier terminated as provided in this Agreement, this Agreement continues until the later of (a) April 14, 2027 or (b) the expiration of all Statements of Work to this Agreement.  However, if either Party is in material breach in the performance of this Agreement, and such breach is not cured within thirty (30) days after the giving of written notice by the other Party specifying the material breach, such other Party shall have the right to terminate this Agreement at any time following such thirty (30) day period.  Any termination of this Agreement shall be in addition to and shall not be exclusive of or prejudicial to any other rights or remedies, at law or in equity, which the terminating Party may have on account of the breach of the breaching Party.  Sections 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16, and 19 will survive the expiration or other termination of this Agreement.

Return of Advances.  In the event of termination or expiration of the Agreement, Service Provider no need to return the remaining balance of any unused payments or other monies advanced to Service Provider by XYZInc, if any.

Return of Materials.  In the event of termination or expiration of the Agreement, Service Provider shall promptly return all materials, documents and Confidential Information to XYZInc and hand over all work in progress to XYZInc.
Fees and Expenses.
The fee and payment schedule (the "Budget") for performance of the Services shall be set forth in detail in each Statement of Work. XYZInc shall pay invoices.

In addition to the Budget, XYZInc shall reimburse Service Provider for all reasonable documented out of pocket expenses incurred by Service Provider on behalf of XYZInc provided that Service Provider has obtained prior written approval from XYZInc to incur such expenses.
All invoices should be mailed to:
XYZInc Inc.
Attn.: Accounts Payable
2603 Camino Ramon suit 200
San Ramon, CA 94583
or through email at pay@XYZInc.com.
Confidentiality.

At all times during the term of Service Provider’s association with XYZInc and thereafter, Service Provider will hold in strictest confidence and will not disclose, use, lecture upon or publish any of the XYZInc’s Confidential Information, except to the extent such use may be required in direct connection with Service Provider’s performing requested Consulting Services for XYZInc or is expressly authorized in writing by an officer of XYZInc.  Service Provider agrees not to disclose XYZInc’s Confidential Information to third parties or to Service Provider’s employees, except to those consultants, service providers, personnel, affiliates or related entities, or other authorized representatives of the receiving party, who are required to have the information in order to evaluate or engage in discussions concerning the Agreement, and who have signed confidentiality agreements containing, or are otherwise bound by, confidentiality obligations and restrictions on use at least as restrictive as those contained herein.  In case of a mandatory disclosure required by law or by order of any court or governmental authority, Service Provider shall first give XYZInc advance written notice so that XYZInc can attempt to obtain a protective order requiring that the Confidential Information be disclosed or used only for the purposes for which the legal requirement or order was issued.  Service Provider will cooperate with XYZInc’s efforts to protect its Confidential Information.

“Confidential Information” means any and all trade secrets, confidential knowledge, personal data, know-how, data or other proprietary information or materials of XYZInc including, without limitation, the terms of this Agreement.  By way of illustration but not limitation, Confidential Information includes: (a) inventions, ideas, samples, prototypes, devices, hardware, software, electronic components and materials, and procedures for producing any such items, as well as data, know-how, improvements, inventions, discoveries, developments, designs and techniques; (b) information regarding plans for research, development, new products, marketing and selling activities, business models, budgets and unpublished financial statements, licenses, prices and costs, suppliers and customers and (c) any other information which is designated as “Confidential,” “Proprietary,” or some similar designation (“Confidential Designations”).  However, XYZInc’s information in tangible form that does not contain a Confidential Designation, and discussions relating to Confidential Information, shall nevertheless be protected hereunder as Confidential Information, if the receiving party knew, or should have reasonably known under the circumstances, that the information was confidential and had been communicated in confidence.  Confidential Information may also include information disclosed to a disclosing party by third parties.

Confidential Information shall not, however, include any information which (i) was publicly known and made generally available in the public domain prior to the time of disclosure by the disclosing party; (ii) becomes publicly known and made generally available after disclosure by the disclosing party to the receiving party through no breach of this Agreement by the receiving party; (iii) is already in the possession of the receiving party at the time of disclosure by the disclosing party as reasonably shown by the receiving party’s files and records or other competent evidence immediately prior to the time of disclosure; or (iv) is independently developed by the receiving party without use of or reference to the disclosing party’s Confidential Information, as can be reasonably shown by documents and other competent evidence in the receiving party’s possession.

In addition, Service Provider understands that XYZInc has received and in the future will receive from third parties confidential or proprietary information (“Third Party Information”) subject to a duty on XYZInc’s part to maintain the confidentiality of such information and to use it only for certain limited purposes. During the term of Service Provider’s association and thereafter, Service Provider will hold Third Party Information in the strictest confidence and will not disclose or use Third Party Information, except in connection with Service Provider’s performing requested Consulting Services for XYZInc, or as expressly authorized in writing by an officer of XYZInc.

Immediately following the termination or expiration of the Agreement, or upon any other request thereto by XYZInc, the Service Provider shall destroy all Confidential Information or return all Confidential Information to XYZInc, in accordance with XYZInc’s request, and shall certify that it no longer possesses or that it has destroyed the Confidential Information (as applicable).
Intellectual Property Rights.

“Intellectual Property” includes, but is not limited to, any patents, rights to inventions, technologies, discoveries, improvements, know-how, technique, copyright and related rights, trademarks, trade names, domain names, designs, databases, trade secrets and other Confidential Information, drawings, reports, specifications, business methods, data, prototypes, protocols, testing methods, market information, business analysis, methods of manufacture or use, software codes or other works, technology, and any other information or materials, whether registered or unregistered and including all applications (or rights to apply) for, and renewals or extensions of, such rights and all similar rights which subsist or will subsist now or in the future in the United States and in foreign jurisdictions.

Service Provider agrees that any and all Intellectual Property that Service Provider invents, suggests, creates, conceives, reduces to practice, or develops, alone or in conjunction with others, during or as a result of performing the Consulting Services for this Agreement, or as a result of receiving Confidential Information under this Agreement, shall be the sole and exclusive property of XYZInc, and shall be promptly disclosed in writing to XYZInc.  Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as an assignment or license of XYZInc’s Intellectual Property rights to Service Provider.

In exchange for valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which Service Provider acknowledges, Service Provider hereby assigns to XYZInc, Service Provider’s entire worldwide right, title, and interest in and to all Intellectual Property invented, suggested, created, conceived, reduced to practice, or otherwise developed by Service Provider as a result of performing the Services of this Agreement, or as a result of receiving Confidential Information under this Agreement.

Service Provider will execute, without further consideration, all documents as requested by XYZInc that may be necessary or desirable to effectuate or document any assignments of rights outlined above.  Service Provider hereby irrevocably designates and appoints XYZInc and its duly authorized officers and agents a power of attorney to act for and on Service Provider’s behalf to execute and file any documents, applications, or related filings and to do all other lawfully permitted acts to further the perfection of assignment of rights and the prosecution and issuance of patents, patent applications, copyright applications and registrations, trademark applications and registrations, or other rights in connection with such Intellectual Property outlined above, with the same legal force and effect as if executed by Service Provider.  Service Provider further agrees to cooperate and provide reasonable assistance to XYZInc (including but not limited to the signing of documents, declarations, assignments, and the providing of testimony) to obtain and from time to time enforce United States and foreign patents, copyrights, and other rights and protections claiming, covering, or relating to the Intellectual Property outlined above, in any and all countries.  Service Provider agrees to ensure compliance of its employees, agents, and representatives with this paragraph.

Service Provider agrees to submit to XYZInc any proposed publication that contains any discussion relating to XYZInc’s Confidential Information, Intellectual Property, or any work performed by Service Provider for XYZInc.  Service Provider further agrees that no such publication shall be made without the prior written consent from XYZInc, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld.
Representations and Warranties.

Service Provider represents that, with respect to any information, knowledge or data disclosed to XYZInc under this Agreement, Service Provider has the full and unrestricted right to disclose the same without incurring legal liability to others, and that XYZInc will have the full and unrestricted right to use and publish the same as XYZInc may see fit.

Service Provider represents that Service Provider has the right and freedom to provide the Consulting Services hereunder and to assign all rights, title and interest in and to the products of such Services to XYZInc.  Service Provider will execute, without further consideration, all documents necessary to effect or document the intent of this section.

Service Provider represents and warrants that Service Provider does not have any prior or existing obligations to assign Inventions and/or Proprietary Information to a third-party, including, but not limited to, Service Provider’s employer, for any ideas, inventions, technologies, discoveries, improvements, know-how, techniques, and data related to high frequency SCS (in the frequency range of 1,500 to 100,000 hertz) or any technology reasonably related to the Services intended under this Agreement.

Indemnity.  Service Provider agrees to indemnify and hold harmless XYZInc of and from any and all claims, demands, losses, causes of action, damage, lawsuits, judgments, including attorneys' fees and costs, arising out of or relating to Service Provider’s work.  The extent of indemnity provided by the Service Provider will be reduced proportionately by the extent that any such losses are due to any unlawful, wrongful or negligent act or omission of XYZInc or any officer or employee of XYZInc.
Compliance with Laws and Regulations.

Service Provider agrees to comply with the terms of any orders, judgments and agreements between XYZInc and any governmental authority or its authorized designee, which relate to the activity under this Agreement, and XYZInc agrees to provide Service Provider with notice of any such order, judgment or agreement.

Anti-Corruption Compliance. Neither party shall perform any actions that are prohibited by local and other anti-corruption laws (collectively “Anti-Corruption Laws”) that may be applicable to one or both parties to the Agreement. Without limiting the foregoing, neither party shall make any payments, or offer or transfer anything of value, to any government official or government employee, to any political party official or candidate for political office or to any other third party related to the transaction in a manner that would violate Anti-Corruption Laws.

Governing Law and Choice of Venue.  This Agreement shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California, without regard to conflicts of laws principles provided, however, that in the event applicable non-U.S. law, rule or regulation mandates the application of the laws and principles of non-U.S. jurisdiction to address the rights and obligations of the parties hereto, the applicable laws, rules and regulations of such non-U.S. jurisdiction shall be applied, which shall supplement and, where necessary, super cede California law, only insofar as is mandated by such non-U.S. law. The Parties agree that any and all litigation arising from this Agreement, and the business relationship created by this Agreement, shall take place exclusively in the state and federal courts of California.

Mediation and Arbitration.  Any dispute arising under this agreement shall be resolved through a mediation-arbitration approach.  The Parties agree to select a mutually agreeable, neutral third party to help mediate any dispute that arises under the terms of this agreement.  Costs and fees associated, with the mediation shall be shared equally by both Parties.  If the mediation is unsuccessful, the Parties agree that the dispute shall be decided by single arbitrator, by binding arbitration under the rules of the American Arbitration Association.  The decisions of the arbitrator shall be final and binding on the Parties and may be entered and enforced in any court of competent jurisdiction by either Party.  The prevailing Party in the arbitration shall be awarded reasonable attorney fees, expert witness costs and expenses, and all other costs and expenses incurred directly, or indirectly in connection with the proceedings, unless the arbitrator shall for good cause determine otherwise.

Damages.  In no event will either Party be liable, whether arising in contract, tort, warranty or otherwise, for any special, indirect, incidental, exemplary, punitive or consequential damages, including, but not limited to loss of anticipated profits.

Force Majeure.  Neither Party to this Agreement will be liable for any delay or failure of performance that is the result of any happening or event that could not reasonably have been avoided or that is otherwise beyond its control, provided that the Party hindered or delayed immediately notifies the other Party describing the circumstances causing delay.  Such happenings or events will include, but not be limited to, terrorism, acts of war, riots, civil disorder, rebellions, fire, flood, earthquake, explosion, action of the elements, acts of God, inability to obtain or shortage of material, equipment or transportation, governmental orders, restrictions, priorities or rationing, unavoidable accidents, strikes, lockouts or other labor trouble or shortage.

Assignment.  Service Provider may not assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of an authorized representative of XYZInc.  XYZInc reserves the right to assign this Agreement, or any rights and interests thereunder, to any parent, subsidiary or affiliate of XYZInc.  All of the terms and provisions of this Agreement will be binding upon, will inure to the benefit of, and be enforceable by successors and assigns of the Parties.  This Agreement does not confer any right or remedy upon any person other than the Parties hereto and their respective successors and permitted assigns.  XYZInc reserves the right to have any affiliated organization of XYZInc issue checks to Service Provider in connection with any payments due to Service Provider under this Agreement.

Third Party Beneficiaries.  The Parties agree that no person or entity other than the Parties hereto is or shall be entitled to bring any action to enforce any provision of this Agreement against any of the Parties hereto.

Notices.  All notices, reports, requests, demands and other communications given under this Agreement shall be in writing and will be deemed to have been duly given if delivered by hand, sent by facsimile or other means of electronic communication with confirmation, sent by a nationally recognized overnight delivery service, or certified mail return receipt requested to:
To XYZInc:
XYZInc Inc.
2603 Camino Ramon suit 200
San Ramon, CA 94583
To Amtrino:
Amtrino Technologies LLC.
6088  Dublin Meadows St
Dublin, CA.

Notices shall be deemed to have been made as of the date of receipt thereof by the person to whom sent, unless otherwise provided in this Agreement.  A Party may change its address listed above by notice to the other Party.

Headings.  The section headings contained in this Agreement are inserted for convenience of reference only and shall not otherwise affect the meaning or interpretation or be deemed to be a substantive part of this Agreement.

Execution of Counterparts.  This Agreement may be executed in two or more duplicate counterparts, each of which will be considered an original, but all of which together will constitute one and the same instrument.

Severability.  If any provision of this Agreement is deemed illegal, invalid or unenforceable, the Parties will endeavor to replace it by another provision that will as closely as possible reflect their original intention.  The validity, legality, and enforceability of the remaining provisions will not in any way be affected or impaired.

Modification, Waiver and Authorized Representative.  This Agreement may not be modified except by a written instrument signed by both Parties.  In the case of a waiver, the written instrument need only be signed by the Party waiving compliance.  For purposes of this Agreement, the authorized representative of XYZInc is the CEO or CFO of XYZInc.  Assuming these conditions are met, this Agreement may be amended, modified, superseded or canceled, and any of the terms, covenants, representations, warranties or conditions of this Agreement may be waived.

Entire Agreement.  This Agreement, including its Schedules, Addendums, Exhibits and Attachments, if any, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes any prior expression of intent or agreement of the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof.  No representation, promise, inducement or statement of intention has been made by either Party that is not embodied in this Agreement or in the documents referred to in this Agreement, and neither Party will be bound by or liable for any alleged representation, promise, inducement or statement of intention not set forth in this Agreement.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties, intending to be legally bound, have executed this Agreement as of the day and year written below.
XYZINC													AMTRINO
